opening.argument: The video presents a Chipotle ordering app whose stated sequence is straightforward: “Touch, Pick and Pay.” It shows location-specific menu items and customizable meals, while the app directs users to the nearest Chipotle and supports pickup without waiting in line. The visible food-selection interface and restaurant-location map reinforce that the activity is ordinary restaurant commerce, involving food selection, payment, directions, and pickup, with no indication of investment returns, credential harvesting, or another deceptive mechanism.

citations.quote: Introducing the new and improved Chipotle ordering app! The premise is simple. Touch, Pick and Pay.
The menu displays specific items available by location, allowing for completely customizable meals all over the world.
The app will give you directions to the nearest Chipotle location, and then—no waiting in line. Walk in, pick up, and eat.
